- **Fuel Sufficiency**: Bounded fuel of 100 in `jsonDepthFuel 100 j` is strictly sufficient for any document meeting the specification limit `depth ≤ 64`, as traversing at most 64 nested containers decrements fuel by at most 64, reaching leaf scalars at remaining fuel `≥ 36 > 0`.
